build_jamba_causal_lm: build a JambaForCausalLM model for autoregressive text generation using vllm_config
build_jamba_sequence_classifier: build a JambaForSequenceClassification model for text classification with custom num_labels
build_jamba_decoder_layers: build JambaMambaDecoderLayer and JambaAttentionDecoderLayer decoder layers for hybrid Mamba-attention architecture
load_jamba_weights: load JambaForCausalLM weights from checkpoint with tensor parallelism and MoE expert mapping
compute_jamba_logits: compute logits from hidden states using JambaForCausalLM logits processor and parallel lm head
